snippet.title: Boxing School 2 (Trailer)
snippet.description:
Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2627410/Boxing_School_2

Description: BOXING SCHOOL 2! Take control of a boxing gym in the 80s. You’ll hire the boxers, teach them to fight and climb the ranks. This is the improved and refined sequel to the management game Boxing School. 

Website: http://www.millendream.com
